title: Extract a game and plan its cleanup
summary: See what the game holds, extract it into a new workspace beside the active one, then plan the cleanup of empty, junk, duplicate and mislabeled files. Nothing is deleted: you review the plan and apply what you want.

steps.title: Review the plan and apply what you want
steps.text: Open CLEANUP: the plan lists every finding with its action. Apply the safe ones, or pick; every apply can be undone.
